description: Source code for Telegram channel configuration and validation within the openclaw project, including functions for normalizing configs, scanning allow-from entries, and repairing username-based allowlists.

classes.name: ChannelDoctorAdapter
classes.description: Interface for channel configuration validation and repair strategies.

methods.name: normalizeTelegramStreamingAliases
methods.description: Normalizes legacy and current streaming configuration entries for Telegram channels.

methods.name: normalizeTelegramCompatibilityConfig
methods.description: Converts legacy Telegram config rules to current format and normalizes config object.

methods.name: hasAllowFromEntries
methods.description: Checks if a list of allowFrom entries contains any non-empty entries.

methods.name: collectTelegramAccountScopes
methods.description: Collects configuration scopes for all Telegram accounts in the config.

methods.name: collectTelegramAllowFromLists
methods.description: Collects references to allowFrom lists within Telegram account groups and topics.

methods.name: scanTelegramAllowFromUsernameEntries
methods.description: Scans config for non-numeric Telegram allowFrom entries (usernames).

methods.name: collectTelegramAllowFromUsernameWarnings
methods.description: Generates warnings for non-numeric allowFrom entries requiring manual resolution.

methods.name: maybeRepairTelegramAllowFromUsernames
methods.description: Attempts to resolve @username entries to numeric IDs using Telegram bot tokens.

methods.name: hasConfiguredGroups
methods.description: Checks if a Telegram account or its parent has configured groups.

methods.name: collectTelegramGroupPolicyWarnings
methods.description: Generates warnings if group policies are misconfigured or missing.

methods.name: collectTelegramEmptyAllowlistExtraWarnings
methods.description: Collects extra warnings related to empty allowlist configurations.

methods.name: hasLegacyTelegramAccountStreamingAliases
methods.description: Detects legacy streaming alias configurations in accounts.
